name: daxko-marketing-agents
description: Marketing skills for the Daxko marketing team. Ships four agents. Agent 9 - Brand Guardian REVIEWS unpublished marketing drafts against Daxko's official brand guidelines, returning a verdict, a six-part scorecard, every violation tied to the rule and the file it breaks, line-by-line fixes and a corrected rewrite. It reviews content; it does not write it. Agent 11 - Thought Leadership & Long-Form WRITES one long-form authority piece - a whitepaper, eBook manuscript, research report or executive byline article - with every unsourced figure left as a visible placeholder. Agent 13 - Content Production WRITES a complete multi-channel content package for one launch, announcement or campaign, drafted together from one locked core message. Agent 18 - Marketing Performance READS marketing numbers already in the chat and says what they mean for a named Daxko Key Result. It fetches nothing and does not decide. NOT for auditing a page that is already live or on staging - that is daxko-brand-qa.
